docs.title: Web Firmware Flasher
docs.text:
Flash the situo5-esp32 firmware directly to your microcontroller from your web browser using Web Serial.

⚠️ Web Serial API Not Supported: Your current browser does not support Web Serial flashing. Please open this page in Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, or Opera on desktop to flash your device. Target Hardware Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3 (ESP32-S3) LilyGo T3 V1.6 (ESP32) Build Profile Release (Standard Firmware) Debug (Verbose Serial Logging) Selected Manifest: ../firmware/heltec_wifi_lora_32_V3/manifest.json Install Firmware Your browser does not support Web Serial. Please use Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge. Web Serial requires a secure HTTPS context.

docs.title: Flashing Instructions
docs.text:
1. Connect your board to your computer using a high-quality USB data cable.
  2. Select your hardware target and build profile using the dropdown menus above.
  3. Click the Install Firmware button.
  4. In the browser popup window, select the USB serial port corresponding to your device and click Connect.
  5. Once connected, the ESP Web Tools dialog will appear. Click Install situo5-esp32 and follow the on-screen prompts to complete installation.
